Bumping the expected value to match whatever the code currently outputs is exactly the failure-mode this rule guards against — if the code's wrong, we've just baked the bug into the test as the new "spec." If the code's right and the test's assumption was stale, that's a legit fix, but I can't tell which one this is from "it's failing."
